timeline.summary: Aica Kogyo has submitted a pre-offer advertisement for a mandatory open offer to acquire 26% of Stylam's public float at ₹2,250 per share.
Stylam Industries announced the voting results of its postal ballot, successfully passing all five resolutions including director appointments and managerial remuneration.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹282.95 Cr (+6.7% YoY), net profit ₹38.25 Cr (+29.3% YoY).
Stylam Industries Limited schedules Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 12, 2026, at 3:30 PM (IST) with **Jagdish Gupta (MD), Manit Gupta (WTD), Kishan Nagpal (CFO)**.
Stylam Industries held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 12, 2026, guiding for 20-25% revenue growth in FY27 driven by the new greenfield laminate plant starting by June/July 2026.
Stylam Industries announced the post-offer advertisement for the open offer by Aica Kogyo, showing acquisition of 2.75% stake for ₹104.88 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹340.52 Cr (+16.5% YoY), net profit ₹42.35 Cr (+13.4% YoY).
